column3: “Go” renders ἔγειρε (“rise”); “count the number of worshipers there” renders “those worshiping in it.”
BSB follows the critical text with “Lord.” “These witnesses” and “that stand” are added.
BSB follows the critical text with “their Lord”; “bodies” renders the singular πτῶμα (“body”).
“All” is added; “will view … will not permit” renders the present tense (“gaze … do not allow”); “their bodies” renders the singular in the first clause.
“Will gloat … will celebrate” renders the present “rejoice … make merry”; “them” renders “those dwelling on the earth.”
“The two witnesses” is added; “breath” renders πνεῦμα (“spirit”).
“The witnesses” is added; “as their enemies watched them” renders “and their enemies beheld them.”
BSB follows the critical text with “the kingdom” (singular); the Textus Receptus has “the kingdoms.”
BSB follows the critical text with no “and who is to come.”
